definitions.explanation: Red spots, bumps, or irritation that appear on the skin, usually as a symptom of illness, allergy, or other medical condition.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}に{赤|あか}い{発疹|ほっしん}ができた。
examples.english: Red spots appeared on my arm.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んだら{全身|ぜんしん}に{発疹|ほっしん}が{出|で}て、すぐに{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: After taking the medicine, a rash appeared all over my body, so I went to the hospital immediately.

notes:
Composed of {発|ほつ} (emit, develop) and {疹|しん} (rash). Can also be read はっしん, though ほっしん is more common in medical and everyday usage. The duplicate check flagged entry 20451 ({発信|はっしん}, transmission) as sharing the same kanji with a different reading — these are unrelated words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発疹|ほっしん}が{出|で}る: a rash appears
- {発疹|ほっしん}が{広|ひろ}がる: a rash spreads
- アレルギー{性|せい}{発疹|ほっしん}: allergic rash
- {薬疹|やくしん}: drug-induced rash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {湿疹|しっしん}: eczema — a specific type of chronic or recurring skin inflammation
- かぶれ: rash from contact — typically caused by touching an irritant (plants, chemicals)
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}: hives, urticaria — raised itchy welts, often from allergies
